faqs.a:
Any retail liquor store, fermented malt beverage and wine retailer, or liquor-licensed
               drugstore licensee wishing to conduct tastings shall submit an application for a permit
               to the city clerk on forms provided by the city clerk's office. Such application shall
               be accompanied by a non-refundable annual fee as set by the city.
(
Ord. No. 4670
, § 1, 12-17-2018; Ord. No.
4839
, § 1, 3-20-2023)
